svg.title: 02 | EEG–EyeLink Time Alignment and Window Eligibility
svg.desc: Recorded EEG–EyeLink temporal pairing in 36 ZuCo 2.0 original source runs from 18 people. The streams are placed on a BIDS-relative time axis using their nominal 500-Hz sampling rates and EyeLink StartTime offsets, which span minus 46 to plus 33 milliseconds. Intersecting the available EEG and eye time intervals yields non-overlapping 12-second candidate windows, with a maximum of 20 per run; a window passes if at least 60 percent of x and y samples are finite. All 630 candidates passed and each original participant/task run contributed at least one window. There are 341 NR and 289 TSR windows and 371 Train, 99 Validation and 160 reserved Test windows. Finite coordinates are a narrow availability measure, not a calibration assessment; independent inter-device clock drift remains unverified.

g.text: 02 | EEG–EyeLink Time Alignment and Window Eligibility
36 paired source runs | 12-second non-overlapping segments | 630 eligible windows

g.aria-label: Schematic EEG recording and left-eye gaze acquisition

g.text: Finite gaze coordinates establish data availability, not gaze calibration or independent clock-drift correction.
Thirty-six paired runs yield 630 eligible windows; unequal run lengths affect per-person sample support.
